name: ECOVACS WINBOT Mini
description: Ecovacs' most compact window-cleaning robot, announced at CES 2025 — about 30% thinner and 37% smaller than its predecessor, aimed at small windows and apartments rather than the large-window, multi-scene positioning of the W2 Pro Omni.

specs.label: Subscription
specs.note: free ECOVACS HOME app; no cloud fee found

sourcing: Specs sourced from Ecovacs' own US product page (ecovacs.com/us/shop/winbot-window-cleaning-robot/winbot-mini), Ecovacs' CES 2025 press release (via PR Newswire), and Ecovacs' own CES campaign page, as of September 2026. No published noise-level (dB) figure was found. No major tech-press outlet appears to have published an independent review of this specific model. robotindex does not sell this product.

pricing.summary: MSRP **$239.99**, seen discounted to around **$199.99** in promotions, per Ecovacs' own US store. Sold via ecovacs.com, Amazon, and Walmart, with orders shipping in about two weeks per the manufacturer's site.

editorial.heading: Sensors & Hardware
editorial.body: The Mini attaches with up to 7,500 Pa suction (3,200 Pa while moving) and detects frameless-glass edges via an optocoupler sensor claimed at 0.02-second response, needing a 3mm minimum frame. A 3.3m tether rated to 1,900N backs the mount, plus a 30-minute battery backup if power/suction fails. Four ultrasonic nozzles and WIN-SLAM path planning give a claimed 99.5% surface coverage.

editorial.heading: Insights
editorial.body: The Mini backs its suction mount with a 3.3m nylon/latex tether rated to 1,900N of tensile strength and detects frameless-glass edges via an optocoupler sensor with a claimed 0.02-second response time — specific, sourced engineering figures rather than generic marketing claims. No major tech-press outlet appears to have published an independent review of this specific model.
